source_of_truth: Deferred from plan 2026-06-06-001 (D018): the governed action channel that lets the operator console originate mutations. Threat-model-first; demand-gated (build only once the read-only copy/handoff loop proves too slow). Acceptance is operator-OUTCOME via named journeys on real state, with adversarial cases (unauthorized/cross-origin/forged/double-submit/stale) as first-class.
completion_test: The operator console can approve/request/reject a live gate and dry-run-then-confirm the auto_safe tier directly from the browser, routed through a localhost action backend that accepts only authenticated, same-origin, CSRF-protected, allowlisted operator_bucket actions; every mutation is confirm-gated, atomic with its evidence, idempotent, tamper-evidently logged, recoverable after interruption, and refused when issued against a stale model fingerprint. Unauthorized, cross-origin, forged, double-submit, and stale-tab attempts are all refused. Proven by named-journey + adversarial tests, not DOM presence.

user_journeys.name: operator-approves-from-browser
user_journeys.description: The human approves/request-changes/rejects a live gate directly in the console with explicit confirmation; the decision commits atomically with its evidence.
acceptance_signals: A confirmed decision clears the gate and records evidence atomically

user_journeys.name: operator-applies-safe-tier-from-browser
user_journeys.description: The human dry-runs then confirms the auto_safe apply from the console, driving the F005 engine via the governed channel, auto_safe-only.
acceptance_signals: Dry-run mutates nothing; confirm applies only auto_safe and records evidence

user_journeys.name: channel-refuses-untrusted-and-stale
user_journeys.description: Adversarial: unauthorized, cross-origin, forged, double-submitted, or stale-fingerprint actions are all refused; the channel never becomes a general shell.
acceptance_signals: Unauthorized / cross-origin / forged requests are refused
Double-submit is idempotent; stale-fingerprint actions are refused
Only allowlisted operator_bucket actions are ever executed; the audit log is tamper-evident
